note: NOTE: These are the four allocatable stats. Each level grants 3 points (v0.1.2, was 5) that can be spent freely on any of them. Effects below are v0 numbers used by combat_formulas and may pivot after playtesting.

rows.name: Strength
rows.description: Warrior's main damage stat (feeds attack ×2). Also +3 max HP per point.

rows.name: Intelligence
rows.description: Mage's main damage stat (feeds attack). Also +5 max MP per point.

rows.name: Agility
rows.description: Rogue's main damage stat (feeds attack). Also +0.4% crit chance and +0.5% attack speed per point. Small dodge: +0.2% per point.

rows.name: Spirit
rows.description: Shared stat for every class. +0.15 MP/s regen per point (added to a 0.5 MP/s base). Also +1% passive essence production speed and +0.5% spiritual resistance per point (placeholders).
